validation_notes: Full G/R3 combined attempts were interrupted after stalled progress; the requested file surface was verified in smaller groups.

The broad G remainder run passed 6612 tests and failed two explicit audit inventories imported before their updates. Both entire affected inventory files passed after the updates. Counts in separate runs overlap and must not be summed as unique coverage.
Four concurrent final tier collection attempts were interrupted to reduce contention and rerun sequentially. No full-suite execution was performed.

The requested absolute non-deductee monotonicity invariant conflicts with the captured single-full-deduction exception. The executed minimized counterexample and qualified invariant are recorded in the design and report; the existing property has no collection-count change.
